# AV Gen error codes

<!-- Generated by `avgen --describe all --out .` (tools/gen_api.sh). Do not edit by hand: tests/unit/test_api_catalogue.cpp fails when this file and the engine disagree. -->

API level 1. A failed call returns `{success: false, error: {code, message, recovery}}`. The set of codes is closed: a client can branch on every one of them. `recovery` says what to do instead.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `INVALID_ARGUMENTS` | The call did not match the tool's input schema, or named something in a form the tool cannot read. Fix the arguments; the message names the field. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | A named parameter, node, track, signal, file or tool does not exist. Look the name up (parameter.search, scene.find_nodes, signal.list, capability.list_tools) and retry. |
| `OUT_OF_RANGE` | A value is outside its hard range. Clamp it into the range the schema or parameter.get reports. |
| `UNSUPPORTED` | A valid request this build cannot serve. Retrying will not help; the recovery text says what the build lacks. |
| `UNAVAILABLE` | The subsystem exists but is not present in this session (no renderer, no audio, no host hook). It may be available in another kind of session. |
| `CONFLICT` | The change would be overwritten by automation or a route, or a name collides. Resolve the conflict the message names. |
| `CANCELLED` | The call was cancelled, or the host did not service it in time. Nothing further was applied. |
| `INTERNAL` | An engine fault. Report it with the message; the project was not necessarily modified. |
